title: Bonus Chapter: The Shield Hero’s One Thousand and One Nights
text: “Ugh…nn…kh…nnh. Uu…”
“Raph…”

I was sitting on the edge of the bed, gazing at Naofumi-sama’s sleeping face as he breathed with such difficulty. Naofumi-sama’s sleep was always terribly light, but lately he’d finally begun to stay asleep even when I came near him. No…when his sleep was deep and pained like this, he wouldn’t wake no matter who approached. Filo had come by once, looking worried, but even she hadn’t roused him.
“Uu…kh…kuuuuh……”
I wiped away the sweat beading on Naofumi-sama’s brow with a cloth. He didn’t have a fever, but I couldn’t help myself, and Raph-chan was doing the same thing of her own accord.
“Raphuu……”
Raph-chan and I were casting illusion magic on Naofumi-sama, trying to twist his nightmare into something gentler, but his breathing rarely seemed to improve.
“Haa……”

For a moment, I found myself remembering when I first met Naofumi-sama. Back then, I used to suffer every night from nightmares about the day my parents died in the Waves. Those nightmares faded once I began spending my days with him…so why did Naofumi-sama’s never stop? You saved me. The world had already been rescued from the threat of the Waves and was at peace now, and everyone was living out calm, quiet days. If anything, the biggest recent event was when Ark and the other godslayers passed through and continued on their journey. Even the reports of reincarnators causing trouble had grown far fewer these days…and yet, faced with Naofumi-sama’s tortured breathing, I couldn’t help feeling uneasy. That was precisely why I muttered a line I would come to regret almost instantly.
“Naofumi-sama…just what sort of nightmare is tormenting you so…”

I suppose you could call it grieving aloud. And of all people, the one who heard that muttered line of mine was someone I truly did not want listening. With a light thud, the Spear Hero phased right through the wall and appeared before me. Please stop walking through walls to get in here! Why does the Raph-species security network let this man through of all people!? That’s what I meant to say, but—
“Big Sister! Motoyasu heard everything, I say!”

The instant I realized my careless mutter had been overheard, I knew without a doubt that I had made a terrible mistake. Of all people, to be overheard by the Spear Hero…I could say with absolute certainty that something bizarre was about to happen. Perhaps I should simply strike him with my hammer until the memory was gone. Yes, hitting him until he forgot seemed the wisest course.
“I see. Please leave before you do anything unnecessary. Somehow I doubt this will end well.”
“Uuh……”

Naofumi-sama groaned in his nightmare. Didn’t it only get worse the moment the Spear Hero got close? If anything, I found myself hoping he’d simply wake up. That would be far better than the nightmare. And yet…given how badly Naofumi-sama neglected sleep as it was, staying up so late, part of me still wanted him to rest peacefully. It was a complicated feeling. For now, I gripped my hammer, intending to drive out the Spear Hero who’d let himself in.
“But Motoyasu wants to help Father too, I say.”
“I understand the sentiment, but please leave.”
“Raph.”

Honestly, I would rather not get involved with him at all, if I’m being truthful. Right after he’d resolved to fight alongside Naofumi-sama as a godslayer, he’d shown me that particular…episode so many times I’d grown thoroughly sick of it. To put it plainly, it had been dreadful. As if flaunting the fact that I could be replaced by anyone at any time…I was aware of it already, but being shown it outright did nothing for my spirits.
“Well, just hear Motoyasu out, I say. Lately, Motoyasu found a weapon that seemed like it might help Father with his nightmares, I say.”

So saying, the Spear Hero transformed his spear into a strange new shape. What in the world was that? At least it wasn’t a cursed weapon—I flatter myself that I can tell the difference between a dangerous weapon and a harmless one.
“Now then, Big Sister, here Motoyasu goes, I say!”

Before I could react, the Spear Hero grabbed my arm and gently touched the tip of the spear to Naofumi-sama. Suddenly, with a whooshing sensation, as though passing through some sort of portal—no, through mist—the scenery around us began to shift.
“Raff!”
Raph-chan clung to me instinctively and came along as well. And so…we arrived in a strange space where the edges of my vision were tinged faintly white.
“What in the world is going on!? What is this place—”
“This is the dream spear Motoyasu found recently, the Dream Lance, I say. Dream-Entering Spear, nano—er, I say!”
“Dream-Entering!?”
The Spear Hero declared this proudly, puffing out his chest with total confidence.

“Indeed, I say. Apparently it’s a weapon for defeating monsters called Nightmares that invade people’s dreams and drain their host’s life force. If Motoyasu uses this spear, we should be able to see exactly what kind of nightmare Father is suffering through, which should help us solve it, I say.”
More than that, the Spear Hero continued, there was a chance some Nightmare-type monster had possessed Father.
“If such a monster had possessed Naofumi-sama, surely we, who can use illusion magic, would have noticed!”
I do have some confidence in my own aptitude, if I say so myself. So I could say with certainty that no such monster dwelled within Naofumi-sama.
“But Big Sister. Does Motoyasu really want to keep watching Father suffer through nightmares night after night forever, I say? He seems to be in real pain, so Motoyasu wants to help too, I say.”
“Raph……”

However reluctant I was to admit it, what the Spear Hero said wasn’t wrong. Raph-chan looked up at me as if she felt the same. Still—was it really right to enter Naofumi-sama’s dream world without his consent?
“At the very least, shouldn’t we get Naofumi-sama’s permission before doing anything?”

“That’s not something Motoyasu would recommend, thinking of Father, I say. It seems that if you get prior consent, the unconscious mind builds a shell to protect and hide the root cause. There’s a high chance we’d end up with no idea what’s actually tormenting him, I say.”
The Spear Hero went on to explain that he’d already run experiments with this very spear.
“Won’t rampaging around inside the dream world cause something terrible to happen to Naofumi-sama…”

“Already tested that too, I say. No matter how much we rampage in the dream world, it seems to be fine, I say. After all, this is meant as a means of rescuing the host from monsters nesting in their dreams. Well, he might see us causing a ruckus in his dream, but since it’s just a dream, there shouldn’t be a problem, I say.”
“Haa……still, there ought to be limits.”
“Of course, I say.”

And so, for better or worse, we found ourselves venturing into the depths of Naofumi-sama’s nightmare. Together with the Spear Hero and Raph-chan…honestly, it left me with rather complicated feelings. Raph-chan was fine, but there was no telling what on earth the Spear Hero might do. For now, this appeared to be…the grasslands of Melromarc, perhaps? It felt strangely nostalgic. Naofumi-sama used to camp out near a stream close to these very grasslands. As I gazed at the old campsite, letting myself sink into memory, I noticed something—a gaping, enormous hole in the ground.
“What is this, I wonder? It’s awfully deep…like some kind of abyss, I say.”
“You don’t know what it is?”
Clatter, clatter—the Spear Hero’s hammer, not just his spear, was shaking.
“Raph.”
Raph-chan’s tail reacted the same way. I tried to peer into it, but I was repelled as though there were an invisible wall.
“It’s as if it’s telling us not to come near, I say…never seen anything like this before, I say. Could this be the cause of the nightmare, I wonder?”
“Is that so?”
“No, Motoyasu doesn’t think so…it feels more like a hole leading into the void…this is probably something else entirely, I say. Somehow, that’s the feeling Motoyasu gets, I say.”

As though he had some inkling of what it was, the Spear Hero moved away from the hole. Both Raph-chan and I sensed that this hole was something we shouldn’t touch. It was probably something separate from Naofumi-sama’s nightmare. The Spear Hero glanced up at the sun in the sky. Perhaps because we were in a dream, the sky looked strange—an odd, indeterminate light, somewhere between day and night. And the sun itself…was black and red, the same shade as Naofumi-sama’s L’Arc Shield. Somehow, it was frightening.

We continued on, watching the scenery shift oddly around us, until we arrived at what looked like the castle town of Melromarc. There was some kind of lively atmosphere—it seemed the whole town had gathered for a celebration. The closest thing I could compare it to was the victory celebration after defeating the Crimson Swine, the mastermind behind the Waves. Demi-humans, Beastmen, and humans alike, all celebrating regardless of race.
“Hero-samas, hooray!”
“Thank you for saving the world from the Waves!”
“Kyaa! Amazing!”
“Truly, the heroes are wonderful!”
It was identical to that world-wide festival held back then.
“About the same scale as when we finally took down the Crimson Swine, I say.”
“So it seems.”
“Raph.”
“How odd, I say. Is this really supposed to be Father’s nightmare, I say?”
I found myself agreeing, honestly. Was Naofumi-sama seeing the dream of the world at peace as a nightmare? Ignoring the lively townsfolk, we walked on.
“Hooray for Spear Hero-sama!”
“Truly the hero who saved the world!”
“So passionate, unable to forgive evil—what a wonderful hero!”
“The world was saved thanks to Hero-sama!”
“Ooh!”
“Hooray for Raphtalia-san!”
“I respect her so much as a hero’s companion!”
The passersby cheered for us like this.
“Ehehe…I say. Is Father dreaming of himself praising Motoyasu, I say?”
The Spear Hero blushed at the men’s praise. Wasn’t this supposed to be a nightmare? Praising you seems like a nightmare in its own right, if you ask me.
“Thank you for calming the Waves!”
“““Waaah!”””
“Thank youuu!”
And just then, someone who looked like Filo—but wasn’t quite—was scattering flowers.
“Filo-tan? A little different, I say. But it makes Motoyasu happy anyway, I say!”
“Raff!”
Raph-chan grabbed the Spear Hero and stopped him just as he was about to head toward the Filo-like girl.
“Raph, raph.”
She was scolding him.
“Ah, Filo-tan! The Filo-tan living inside Father’s heart, I say.”
“Ahaha, thanks, Spear Guy!”
“Woohoo! Father is having such a wonderful dream, I say!”
“That’s exactly why I keep telling you—it’s supposed to be a nightmare!”
What in the world was this? Was Naofumi-sama secretly praising the Spear Hero in his subconscious, and calling that a nightmare?
“It’s nice, feeling recognized by Father, I say!”
“That would only be a nightmare for the rest of us. Praising you continuously would count as a nightmare for anyone else…”
I was starting to wonder if this was the actual cause, when the townspeople suddenly began whispering behind their hands.
“And in contrast, the Shield Hero never did a single decent thing, did he…”
“Yeah, wasn’t there rape involved?”
“Extortion, human trafficking, drugs, mismanaging monsters, and on top of all that, he turned out to be the cause of the Waves.”
“Truly a demon lord. It’s a wonder the other heroes managed to capture him at all.”
“Yeah…finally, the Waves are over, thank god.”
Raph-chan, the Spear Hero, and I all heard these murmurs quite clearly.
“……Wait just a moment, I say. The Waves ended because Father defeated the true mastermind, the Crimson Swine herself, I say.”
“What are you talking about? Everyone knows the mastermind behind the Waves was the Shield Devil, obviously.”
When the Spear Hero pressed the gossiping townsperson, that was the venomous reply he got. What on earth was going on here?
“Hey! Listen up, I say! We need to correct this misunderstanding, I say! The mastermind behind the Waves was not Father! It was the Crimson Swine, I say!”
The Spear Hero radiated killing intent as he tried to set the record straight. The atmosphere felt eerily similar to the days when the Three Heroes Church had a stranglehold over Melromarc.

“Hahaha! Spear Hero-sama, you must still be half-asleep. You dueled the Shield Devil, defeated him, and rescued that poor tragic slave—surely you are the true hero who saved the world! Mercy toward devils is a virtue, but that man deserves none of your kindness.”
The strange atmosphere left all of us feeling deeply uneasy.
“Kyaa! Spear Hero-sama!”
“So wonderful!”
“Amazing!”
“Thank you for bringing peace to the world!”
“You truly are the savior!”

Sudden, high-pitched cheering rose up from somewhere in the distance, drawing steadily closer. The townspeople, ignoring us with unnatural abruptness mid-conversation, rushed off toward the source of the excited voices. Of course…this was a dream world. Perhaps its inhabitants simply ignored anything too unnatural, being mere figments themselves. At the source of that shrill cheering was… the Spear Hero, walking cheerfully with a crowd of girls trailing behind him, waving happily. Beside him, that princess—the one who’d already been executed and defeated in reality—walked along too, waving with an innocent, pure expression on her face. And closer still, standing right there, was someone who looked exactly like me.
“Thank you for saving the world from the Waves, Motoyasu-sama!”
Yes…there was no mistaking it, that was me. It was like staring into a mirror. Though the line coming out of her mouth was thoroughly unpleasant.
“R-Raph……”
Raph-chan frowned, glancing back and forth between me and this other me.
“Thank you for saving me from that man who overworked me and forced me to fight against my will!”
“No one…no one should ever enslave another person! Especially not us heroes from another world—that kind of behavior is unforgivable!”

That…was almost word-for-word the same line the Spear Hero had spouted when he challenged Naofumi-sama to that duel in the castle, right after we survived the second Wave, once he’d learned of my circumstances.
“How nostalgic. Thanks to you, I was freed from that man!”

Kyaa! The not-me me let out a grating, thoroughly unpleasant squeal and wrapped her arm around the Spear-Hero-lookalike’s. She was practically wagging her tail with fawning flattery. It reminded me unpleasantly of Takt and his entourage of women—how utterly infuriating. I could feel my irritation mounting by the second.
“Hahahahaha! It was nothing at all. I merely did what any hero would consider natural! Hahaha! Now then, let’s make the world an even better place!”
“Yes! Motoyasu-sama!”

What is with that “Yes! Motoyasu-sama!”?! The fact that she looked exactly like me made it all the more infuriating! What on earth was that thing!? Fueled by pure irritation, I felt magic surging through my body, my hair beginning to lift on its own.
“R…Raphuuuu……”
Raph-chan looked at me, her face pale with confusion, but I paid her no mind.

“I suppose this is it, then. On the day of that duel, deep in his subconscious, Naofumi-sama must have believed that once I was no longer a slave, I would simply walk away and fall for the Spear Hero instead… is that it?”
And regarding the Waves themselves—somehow, none of that matched reality either, which bothered me as well.

“I suppose this is what counts as Naofumi-sama’s nightmare, then… No…knowing Naofumi-sama, he probably believes all of this represents some convenient wish-fulfillment on his own part, and that this must be closer to the truth than reality itself.”

Now that I thought of it, he always seemed to look almost relieved upon waking—was this the reason why? Regardless, that other me was thoroughly infuriating. I felt genuinely insulted. So this was what Naofumi-sama secretly thought of me, deep in his unconscious mind. This… No matter how much I cared for Naofumi-sama, this much I could not forgive. After everything we’d been through together, after I’d finally confessed my feelings and thought he’d finally understood—only to learn that deep down, he apparently believed something else entirely.
“HAHAHA! What’s so funny, I wonder? There seems to be a reincarnator here who looks like Motoyasu and speaks ill of Father, so annihilation is in order, I say!”
“Gah—w-who do you think you—”

Shhhk! With a single thrust, the Spear Hero skewered his own dream-double—no, I suppose “his old self” is the more fitting description, that overly passionate but skirt-chasing version of Naofumi-sama’s imagination.
“Anyone who torments Father deserves destruction, I say! Drop dead, I say! Burst Lance X!”
“Waaaagh—!?”
Boom! With a spectacular explosion, the other Spear Hero was blown to bits.
“Aaaaaah!? Motoyasu-samaaaaa!?”
“I would never say something like that!”
Crack! I brought my hammer down squarely on the head of that revolting fake me.

“In what world does a version of me exist who’d go insane over the Spear Hero exploding! If such a person existed, she wouldn’t be me—she’d be someone else entirely, because if it were really me, I’d simply hit her! Like this!”
Yes, I would never forgive myself for behaving that way, not even in some parallel world.
“Kyaaaaaah!? Motoyasu-samaaaaaa!”
“You’re just as noisy. I won’t hold back on you either.”
Since that princess had started screeching too, I didn’t hesitate to bring my hammer down on her as well.
“Gyaaah—!?”
“Motoyasu can’t be forgotten either, I say! Death to the Crimson Swine, I say!”
“Guhhhh-aaaaaaaaaah!?”

In one smooth motion, the Spear Hero ran that princess through as well. Considering how hard I’d hit her without her even fainting, she must be tough. Then again…since this was a dream world, perhaps killing something here didn’t actually kill it.
“Raphuuuuu!!”
Raph-chan was thrashing her tail against the fake me’s face over and over.
“Yes, quite right. I intended to be gentle for Naofumi-sama’s sake, but I think holding back entirely is the wrong approach here.”
Honestly…when it comes to Naofumi-sama…he really is hopeless. I felt utterly humiliated, knowing that my heartfelt confession hadn’t truly been believed after all.
“In any case…we need to tear this nightmare world of Naofumi-sama’s completely apart, then find him and talk some sense into him.”
He couldn’t be allowed to keep having this kind of nightmare forever. Something about this course of action felt slightly wrong, but there was nothing else to do but press forward.
And so began our one-night adventure through the stage of Naofumi-sama’s dream world.
April Fools' Day
